message:
I remember the time my phone died right as I was trying to find my way home during a storm. It was a reminder of how crucial it is to be prepared, not just for the big things, but for those little moments when technology fails us. Having a well-thought-out kit can make all the difference, providing comfort and essentials when you need them most. 

Whether it’s a power outage or a sudden change in plans, it’s nice to have peace of mind knowing you’re ready for anything. What’s one item you think is essential to have in your own kit?
